coverage_assessment: Bounded first pass using six actual public searches: four weekly date windows, English/Russian date/sector terms, a Belarusian-language student/pensioner/worker/women/regional query and an adjacent-month episode query. Four exact in-month pages were opened; one off-month result was checked and excluded. S001 records three separately described Dec6 response locations, S002 describes Dec13 dispersed courtyard activity with only an unallocatable citywide police estimate, S004 reports one Zolotaya Gorka column of 50 via a secondhand chain but no candidate-specific demand, and S003 describes separately located Dec27 actions without quantitative counts. All six candidates remain pending required threshold and/or demand fields; zero verified provisional candidates. No counts/arrests pooled or transferred; no attendance inferred from state response. Women, worker, student, pensioner and regional exact-date coverage remains partial. Research occurred 2026-10-11, after the evidence cutoff 2026-10-07. Official baseline and scientific review remain pending.
